note.en: Be careful when using this weapon as it is easy to overcap on [[stat:cr]].
note.fr: Faites attention en utilisant cette arme, puisqu'il est facile de dépasser le maximum de [[stat:cr]].
note.it: Fai attenzione quando usi quest'arma, poiché è facile superare il limite massimo di [[stat:cr]].

note.en: Maximizing this weapon's passive stacks requires [[character:clorinde]] to use her [[ability:burst]] before her [[ability:skill]].
note.fr: Maximiser les stacks du passif de l'arme nécessite que [[character:clorinde]] utilise son [[ability:burst]] avant son [[ability:skill]].
note.it: Per massimizzare gli accumuli di quest'arma, utilizza il [[ability:burst]] di [[character:clorinde]] prima della sua [[ability:skill]].
note.ru: Для набора уровней Пассивной способности оружия требуется использовать [[ability:burst|Взрыв стихии]] перед [[ability:skill|Элементальным навыком]].

note.en: If [[character:clorinde]] is played with a [[element:geo]] character on the team, this weapon performs similarly to **[[weapon:mistsplitter-reforged]]**.
note.fr: Si [[character:clorinde]] est jouée avec un personnage [[element:geo]] dans l'équipe, cette arme performe de manière similaire à **[[weapon:mistsplitter-reforged]]**.

note.en: Ranking assumes [[character:clorinde]] is being shielded by someone, most notably being [[character:kirara]].
note.fr: Le classement suppose que [[character:clorinde]] est protégée par un bouclier, notamment par [[character:kirara]].
note.it: La classifica presuppone che [[character:clorinde]] sia protetta da uno scudo (es. [[character:kirara]]).

note.en: Be careful when using this weapon as it is easy to overcap on [[stat:cr]].

note.en: At **[R5]**, this weapon will perform close to **[[weapon:pjc]]**.
note.fr: Une fois **[R5]**, cette arme performe de manière similaire à **[[weapon:pjc]]**.

note.en: Ranking assumes [[character:clorinde]] is being shielded by someone, most notably being [[character:kirara]]. Otherwise, this weapon ranks below **[[weapon:the-black-sword]]**.
note.fr: Le classement suppose que [[character:clorinde]] est protégée par un bouclier, notamment par [[character:kirara]]. Sinon, cette arme performe moins bien que **[[weapon:the-black-sword]]**.
